newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer confirsm Harmann to sell food unit.
newsitem.headline: Bayer confirsm Harmann to sell food unit.

text.p: German chemical giant Bayer AG on Monday confirmed a report that its Haarmann & Reimer (H&R) subsidiary was divesting its food ingredients business unit.
Bayer said in a statement it was making contacts with a view to finding a buyer for the unit, which is primarily a producer of citric acid.

Bayer said the unit was still regarded as being competitive, but is no longer a core business for H&R. The food ingredients business unit had sales of $293 million last year and employed 1,310 people worldwide.
H&R will in the future concentrate on the manufacture and sale of flavours, fragrances and aroma chemicals.
In 1996 H&R's turnover grew over 21 percent to more than 1.7 billion marks.
